steps.ponr: WATCH, not confirmed: Positive Mental Attitude's missable status is under investigation (PowerPyx, U7Buy) because a Chapter 1 meditation spot may not be reachable later. Meditating on first visit makes the question moot.
steps.summary: The prologue and Chapter 1. One habit starts here and protects the whole run: meditate at every meditation spot you pass. One trophy's missable status is under investigation, and a Chapter 1 spot is the risk.
steps.title: First light in Leonida

steps.summary: Chapters 2 to 4 and the named story missions as they unlock. Story choices count toward Actions Speak Louder, so simply play and choose - never reload to change an answer.
steps.title: The campaign

steps.summary: The character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), Bret's hunt, and eight stranger strands across Leonida. Strands unlock through the campaign, so run this alongside step 2 rather than after it.
steps.title: Friends, strangers and final favours

steps.ponr: No confirmed point of no return exists anywhere in the game at launch. The only flagged risk in the whole run is the step-1 meditation watch, and it is unconfirmed.
steps.summary: The final mission and the campaign's gold trophy. Nothing confirmed locks away after the finale - free roam continues - but keep one save from before it until the step-1 watch settles.
steps.title: The finale

steps.effort: The long middle - spread across the whole run
steps.summary: Counts and collections, best worked district by district alongside the campaign: cards, WAiNK spots, meditation spots, vehicles, stunts, range medals, races and challenges. Starting these early is the difference between a grind and a habit.
steps.title: The Leonida grind

steps.effort: A few evenings - money feats fund each other
steps.summary: Crime feats, partner feats, the money trophies, and the cryptic hidden trophies. Five of the hidden ones still have no confirmed method - their pages say so plainly, label the reading as inference, and tell you the safe habit that covers the plausible trigger.
steps.title: Free-roam feats and fortune

steps.summary: Close out the in-game 100% checklist for A Long Road; the platinum follows the other 54 on its own. If the checklist stalls, work its categories, not random trophies.
steps.title: 100% and the Legend
